2607.09632.title: Lean-QIT: Towards a Formal Infrastructure for Quantum Information Theory
2607.09632.paper_summary: Quantum information theory (QIT) characterizes the capabilities and fundamental limits of quantum information processing, underpinning quantum communication, computation, and error correction. Formalizing its coding theorems requires connecting finite-block protocols, analytic inequalities, and asymptotic limits within a unified machine-checked framework. Existing developments, however, lack a reusable operational layer that defines codes, error criteria, achievable rates, and capacities independently of their information-theoretic characterizations. In this work, we present LeanQIT, a Lean 4 library for finite-dimensional QIT. It provides composable, kernel-checked interfaces for quantum states and channels, source and channel codes, finite-block performance criteria, hypothesis testing, one-shot quantities, and asymptotic rate constructions. Using this infrastructure, we formalize Schumacher's quantum source-coding theorem, the Holevo--Schumacher--Westmoreland classical-capacity theorem, and the entanglement-assisted classical-capacity theorem together with its strong converse. By separating operational definitions from analytic characterizations and exposing reusable achievability, converse, and asymptotic components, Lean-QIT provides a machine-readable foundation for formal QIT and a compositional knowledge substrate for emerging AI-assisted formalization, automated proof search, and agentic reasoning in quantum information and computation.
2607.09632.paper_summary_zh: 量子資訊理論 (QIT) 描述了量子資訊處理的能力和基本限制，支撐著量子通訊、計算和錯誤更正。形式化其編碼定理需要在統一的機器檢查框架內連接有限區塊協議、分析不等式和漸近極限。然而，現有的發展缺乏一個可重用的操作層，該層獨立於其資訊理論特徵定義編碼、錯誤標準、可達速率和容量。在這項工作中，我們提出了 LeanQIT，一個用於有限維 QIT 的 Lean 4 庫。它提供了可組合的、內核檢查的量子狀態和通道、源和通道編碼、有限區塊性能標準、假設檢驗、一擊量和漸近速率構造的介面。利用這一基礎設施，我們形式化了舒馬赫的量子源編碼定理、霍雷沃-舒馬赫-韋斯特莫蘭的經典容量定理，以及糾纏輔助的經典容量定理及其強對偶。通過將操作定義與分析特徵分開，並揭示可重用的可達性、對偶和漸近組件，Lean-QIT 為正式的 QIT 提供了一個機器可讀的基礎，並為新興的 AI 輔助形式化、自動證明搜索和在量子資訊和計算中的代理推理提供了一個組合知識基底。
